message.content: Based on the conversation, Wolfgang prefers a well-done meat patty in a burger because he believes it is "just safer and more flavorful." He appreciates the juiciness and the presence of a little char on the patty, suggesting that he values the natural taste and texture of the meat. However, he acknowledges that his preference leans towards medium rare as well, indicating that he enjoys both levels of doneness depending on the occasion. His comment about the safety and flavor of a well-done patty aligns with his preference for a fully cooked and flavorful burger.
